description: This file defines the BlockPickerOption class, extending a typeahead option, used for representing selectable options with associated metadata such as icon, keywords, and onSelect behavior in a block picker component.

classes.name: BlockPickerOption
classes.description: Represents an option within a block picker UI component, including display properties and selection behavior.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of BlockPickerOption with specified title and options, setting properties and binding the onSelect callback.
